brief: Sales offsite for 40 people, 2 nights sometime in May 2027, somewhere warm by the sea. Budget EUR 60,000 all in. 6 of the group are vegetarian and 1 uses a wheelchair.

turns.text: Warm candidates: lis-baia, pmi-llum, lis-farol, pmi-olivera.

input.summary: Three warm, step-free coastal venues in Mallorca and Portugal fit May and come in around EUR 31-32k, well under the EUR 60,000 budget. All need budget-owner sign-off (over EUR 20,000) plus expert review. Quotes assume no breakout rooms since none were requested, and they include estimated group flights from Berlin.

offers.tradeOff: Warm (24°C), preferred vendor and a right-sized estate, but only 3 breakout rooms and 45 max capacity.
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

offers.tradeOff: Cheapest and warm (23°C) seafront, but arrival is no earlier than 10 May and it has only 3 breakout rooms.
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

offers.tradeOff: Beach resort with a pool and 5 meeting rooms for flexibility, but a larger property and a longer flight (about 290 min).
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

rfp.subject: RFP: Sales offsite for 40 guests, May 2027, 2 nights
rfp.body:
Hello,

Demo Co. is planning a sales offsite and would like a proposal.

Dates: arrival on [proposed date: 1 May 2027 or 10 May 2027, depending on venue], 2 nights.
Guests: 40.
Room nights: 80 (40 single-occupancy rooms x 2 nights).
Meeting space: one plenary room for 40 plus day delegate packages (lunch and coffee) for 3 days. Please list any breakout rooms available and their cost.
Dietary: 6 vegetarian.
Accessibility: 1 wheelchair user. We need step-free access and an accessible room.
Budget: all-in EUR 60,000 for the group, including travel.

Please include room rates, meeting and catering costs, and cancellation terms.

Please reply by 2026-10-30.

Thank you,
Demo Co. Events
